fields.summary_ko.0: Anthropic (ANT) IPO with target price of $70-78 (upside possible), with retail investors' first-day net purchases estimated at approximately $250M, double the size of SpaceX IPO.
fields.summary_ko.1: Anthropic targeted to raise approximately $64.4 billion with an enterprise value of $1.405T, with individual investors expected to receive up to 20% allocation of the initial offering.
